incidents.summary: PESP and the Sierra Club urged Bridgepoint-owned ECP to condition its proposed Gavin coal-plant acquisition on retirement by 2028, but a January 2025 report stated that ECP did not intend to retire the plant.

sources.title: PESP sends letters to Blackstone, ECP urging Gavin coal plant retirement
sources.quote: PESP, along with the Sierra Club, sent letters to Blackstone and Energy Capital Partners/Bridgepoint Group urging the firms to condition the sale on an announcement of retirement of Gavin no later than 2028.

sources.title: Potential Gavin owner Energy Capital Partners won’t retire plant
sources.quote: Contrary to energy transition claims, Bridgepoint-owned ECP has stated that it does not intend to retire the coal plant.

incidents.summary: Public Citizen alleged that subsidiary Calpine Energy Solutions failed to identify its ultimate ECP and Bridgepoint ownership in an application to renew authorization to export electricity to Mexico.

sources.title: Protest of Calpine's Application to Export Power - Public Citizen
sources.quote: On November 22, 2024, Calpine Energy Solutions LLC applied for renewal of its authorization to export electricity from the United States to Mexico as a power marketer.

sources.title: Protest of Calpine's Application to Export Power - Public Citizen
sources.quote: This description of Calpine Energy Solutions’ upstream ownership is incomplete, as it conceals that Calpine Corporation is a wholly-owned subsidiary of the private equity firm Energy Capital Partners, which in turn is affiliated with the UK financial holding company Bridgepoint Group.

sources.title: Protest of Calpine's Application to Export Power - Public Citizen
sources.quote: The failure of the application to correctly identify that it is ultimately controlled by Energy Capital Partners and Bridgepoint Group is a fatal error.
